text:
Priya Nair: quick check — can we run a 90-min mini-workshop next week to finalize the Nimbus Cloud Quickstart (Terraform module + reference architecture) so we can get their marketplace listing ready? target: 2-week ship window. need: module scaffold, CI smoke tests, security checklist, and a one-page refarch diagram.

Alex Chen: +1. 90 mins sounds good. attendees: partner eng lead, our marketplace eng, docs, and perf QA. can we aim for Wed morning PST? also need agreed supported regions and a compatibility matrix for instance families.

Daniel Brooks: I can drop a starter Terraform module skeleton today — will include inputs/outputs and a simple example. thinking outputs: vpc_id, subnet_ids, load_balancer_dns, module_version. will also add a small `examples/` folder with a minimal deploy. snippet: 
```hcl
module "nimbus_quickstart" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/nimbus-quickstart.git//modules/nimbus"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}

output "lb_dns" {
  value = module.nimbus_quickstart.lb_dns
}
```

Sofia Martinez: I can own the refarch doc and the diagram. will put a single-page diagram (network + optional on-prem connector) and a bullet list of integration points for our console and telemetry hooks. prefer diagrams.net export + PNG/SVG for marketplace assets. also: we need a short runbook for onboarding (how to pin model versions, logging paths, and recommended autoscale settings).

Alex Chen: for CI/tests — recommend Terratest for infra validation + a lightweight smoke suite that uses a tiny model artifact (or dummy endpoint) to assert inference path works end-to-end. GH Actions matrix: [linux-ubuntu, arm64-graviton]. add a step to run `snyk`/`trivy` scan on the container images and a simple `runtimes/compatibility.md`.

Marketplace Bot: reminder — marketplace packaging checklist: partner-signed SLA PDF, security scan report, reference arch diagram, terraform examples, and a listed set of supported regions. listings without signed SLA or security scan will be blocked. See https://partners.marketplace/docs/publish-checklist

Priya Nair: great. action items: Daniel — push skeleton repo + examples by EOD today. Sofia — draft refarch + diagram by Monday. Alex — draft CI matrix + Terratest examples and link to `runtimes/compatibility.md`. I'll schedule the 90-min workshop for Wed 10:00 PST and invite Nimbus eng lead + marketplace PM.

Alex Chen: ping me if Nimbus needs a pre-req access (partner account/roles). i'll also add a short perf checklist: seq-len defaults, batch sizes to try, and KV cache notes.

Priya Nair: thanks all — I'll send calendar invite + include preliminary agenda: 1) quick goals & success criteria, 2) module API + examples, 3) CI/test plan, 4) marketplace packaging steps, 5) timelines + owners. linking sample agenda and repo template in invite. :thumbsup:
